name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Active Forever Saunas stand up to the name and provide a lifetime (limited) warranty on all heaters installed in each infrared sauna room and a 3 year warranty on all the rest electrics. They also offer free shipping for every sauna unit and competitive prices, which is quite an appealing trait in Infrared Sauna manufacturers.



These infrared saunas might not be as well designed as other infrared sauna units and do look somewhat boxy, but they do serve their purpose and provide a quite comfortable sauna session every time. This is supported by double walls made from hemlock fir wood, a special control panel located inside the unit, a CD player to help relax with any music you like, an AM/FM radio, a reading light to provide you with enough light to enjoy a book, newspaper or a magazine.



Relaxation and beautification, stress and pain relief, weight loss and overall health improvement – all this is at your reach with Active Forever Saunas.
